quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.

activation.condition: A left turn onto a highway with one exclusive shared bidirectional center turn lane is completed in that lane.

obligation.description: Merge with traffic without traveling more than 50 feet in the center turn lane after the left turn.

timing.description: Measure original center-lane path from turn completion to the first through-lane merge; censor if no merge is observed.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original highway designation, lane topology, markings and use in both directions.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: after making a left-hand turn onto the highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Locate observed turn completion from original body and lane history, not controller intent.
Locate first observed through-lane merge and receiving traffic; absent merge is censored.

parameter_refs.name: merge_station_target
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: requested 49, 50 or 51 feet after turn; original distance separately measured

parameter_refs.name: highway_lane_site
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed single exclusive bidirectional center turn lane
